sinopsis.es: David, un niño negro de seis años, sufre acoso escolar por el color de su piel y la falta de dientes. Cuando le piden que lleve una foto escolar, la esconde de sus padres para evitar más burlas. Pero su bisabuelo Leandro se entera y le fabrica una dentadura postiza de yuca. Juntos, se preparan para la foto.
sinopsis.en: David, a six-year-old Black boy, is bullied at school for the color of his skin and his missing teeth. When he is asked for a school photo, he hides it from his parents to avoid more teasing. But his great-grandfather Leandro finds out and makes him false teeth out of yuca. Together, they get ready for the photo.
